instrument: Loudoun County Board of Supervisors action, September 2 2026 (Randall substitute motion)
summary: The Board voted unanimously to request a county attorney legal opinion on amending the February 2025 grandfathering resolution, due October 6 2026. The Briskman/TeKrony resolution to end grandfathering was not adopted. The memo stays confidential; the Chair asked that the advice be shared publicly on October 6.
notes: Grandfathering covers applications accepted before February 12 2025; the ZOAM adopted March 18 2025 (7-2) ended by-right; applications within 500 feet of residential are excluded from grandfathering. COUNT CONFLICT: 17 grandfathered applications (Virginia Business) vs 'nearly two dozen' (Technical.ly) vs 'over 40' originally exempted (Loudoun Climate Project). The county's list requested by the Board is the primary to wait for.
